swim-spas.name: Swim spas
swim-spas.title: Swim, move and soak at home, all year.
swim-spas.believe: Swim spas are for people who want to move every day without driving to a pool. Swimmers who are tired of lane schedules, families who want a pool the kids can use all twelve months, even through a Canadian winter, and anyone who wants low-impact exercise and a hot soak afterwards, in their own backyard.
moments: Swim against the current before work. No pool schedule, no drive, no lanes to share.
The kids splash in the swim end while you soak in the seats. It's a pool and a hot tub in one.
Steam rising off the water, snow on the cover, and a warm swim when every outdoor pool in North Grenville is closed.
swim-spas.meta: Platinum Spas swim spas in Kemptville. River jet and 16-speed turbine models for swimming, fitness and family time. Text Blaine for your price.
swim-spas.help: Not sure between a river jet and a turbine, or whether you need a split-temperature model? Tell Blaine how you'll use it and he'll tell you straight which one fits.

mini-pools.name: Mini pools
mini-pools.title: A real pool that fits your yard.
mini-pools.believe: The Chronos is for people who want a pool without giving up the whole backyard. It sits flush in the ground like a pool, it's heated for year-round use, and its adjustable current means you can swim, train or just float.
mini-pools.meta: The Platinum Spas Chronos mini pool in Kemptville. An in-ground, heated mini pool with an adjustable swim current. Text Blaine for your price.

river.name: River jet
river.short: Strong jets push a current you swim against. They double as massage jets for the cool-down, and they suit people who want a swim and a soak.

turbine.name: 16-speed turbine
turbine.short: A belt-driven turbine pulls a wide, smooth current across the whole lane, with no bubbles or turbulence. Sixteen speeds run from gentle to hard training. It's the choice for serious swimmers.

models.head: The compact way to swim at home.
models.why: The Eros is one of the most compact swim spas we carry, at just under 15 ft long, and there's still plenty of room to swim or play. Three river jets give you a current to swim against, and the two seats at the end give you a real hot tub soak afterwards.

models.seating: Two hot tub seats at one end, with large massage jets for your back and shoulders after a swim.
models.honest: It's one body of water, so the swim end and the seats are the same temperature. If you want a cooler swim and a hotter soak at the same time, look at the Helios.

models.why: The Eros Pro is the same compact size as the Eros, but the current comes from a 16-speed turbine instead of jets. That gives you a broad, even flow without the turbulence, and you can step it down for a child learning to swim or up for a real workout.

models.head: A real pool that fits your yard.
models.why: The Chronos is a mini pool. It goes in the ground and sits flush like a regular pool, but at about 19 ft 8 in by 7 ft 5 in it fits a yard that a full pool never would. It's heated for year-round use, and its adjustable current lets you swim, train or just float. The full-width step at the back makes it easy to get in and out.
